caption.text:
sometimes we leave before we are left.⁠
⁠
sometimes we call it timing.⁠
sometimes fear.⁠
sometimes we already know how the story ends⁠
and choose to become the villain first.⁠
⁠
for the hearts that loved with one foot out the door.
